title: Codex App vs ChatGPT

body.text: ChatGPT can chat about anything, but Codex is
— it connects to a real repo, reads the whole project, edits multiple files at once, and can open a Pull Request itself.

example: "Tell Codex: 'Fix the bug where the login page doesn't redirect after a successful login' — it finds the relevant files and fixes the whole set"

title: When to use which

body.text: asking concepts/learning → ChatGPT · making real edits in a repo → Codex
— if the task needs to touch multiple files, run tests, or open a PR, that's a sign to use Codex.

example: "'Explain async/await' → ChatGPT / 'Convert the whole project's API from callbacks to async/await' → Codex"
